Investigate the myth of the fearsome Hugo across four cities, climb the Paradox Tower near Kazordoon and face the questions of the mad {npc:Riddler}. After being thrown into Hellgate, you find out your secret 'mathemagics' number from {npc:A Prisoner} in Mintwallin and return to the Riddler to enter the treasure room, where you take up to two of four rewards.
